_: The variant register, and the source of truth for both tools/publish.mjs and
the portal at index.html. Same convention as _buro test 1 and _buro test 3:
A VARIANT IS A FILE, NOT A BRANCH AND NOT A FOLDER. It is `indexN.html` at the
top of this folder, published as it stands, sharing `assets2/`. GitHub serves
the repository whole, so publishing is: build, copy to the top of this folder,
regenerate the portal, commit. There is no second branch and no second repo.
`from` is the path inside dist/ that the build emits. `file` is the published
name. Order is presentation order: newest first.
A variant is REMOVED by deleting its entry here, deleting its indexN.html, and
`shotAt` is the element previews/indexN.jpg is captured at. It matters: two of these
three are the whole site and both open on the same act 00 photograph, so shooting the
top gave two identical cards for two builds whose whole difference is act 02.
title: Luxe Corsa
subject: 121 private automotive suites — Lake Zurich, Illinois
note: An unaffiliated redesign study. Figures verified against luxecorsa.com, read 4 September 2026.

variants.name: The full site · V6
variants.note: The whole homepage with the newest act 02. Precast walls, sectional doors with glazed heads, and the buildings own wall lights — which are what light the elevation when you select one. Every move between buildings is a camera flight, not a cut. One control, ALL BUILDINGS, always in the same place, always means the whole compound. The product panel does not move when the suite does.

variants.name: Act 02 on its own · V6
variants.note: The same interface with nothing around it. Eleven buildings, 121 doors. Hover a building and its practicals come up along the run; point at a real garage door and it names the suite; buildings 02 and 10 have two rows and a control to go round to the second one.

variants.name: The full site
variants.note: The whole homepage, with act 02 replaced by the guided sales interface. Choose one of eleven buildings on the model, then move straight to any other — the navigator is one line across the dock and every building stays clickable, so nothing sends you home to change your mind. Pick a suite and the real door lights up; the price and the size follow.

variants.name: Act 02 on its own
variants.note: The same interface with nothing around it — the fastest way to judge the switching, the hover language, the suite rail and the site plan without scrolling a page to reach them.

variants.name: The site as it stands
variants.note: The same eight acts with the earlier act 02: an SVG drawing and a record column rather than a model. Kept beside the others because the comparison is the argument.
